title: Pendulum Entertainment Group Announces Strategic Live Entertainment Partnership with Caesars Entertainment for 2027
summary: Pendulum Entertainment Group Announces Strategic Live Entertainment Partnership with Caesars Entertainment for 2027 LAS VEGAS, NV (July 29, 2026) Pendulum Entertainment Group has officially confirmed a partnership with Caesars Entertainment for a new immersive live entertainment experience set to debut at PH Live, the award-winning venue inside Planet Hollywood Resort Casino, in 2027. The upcoming production, Arcade Orchestra , will bring a high-energy, fully immersive, multi-generational performance to the resort, expanding Planet Hollywoods commitment to delivering dynamic, world-class entertainment options to the Las Vegas Strip. "We are thrilled to collaborate with the team at Caesars Entertainment to bring this dynamic, captivating vision to life," said Jonathan DaSilva, Co-Founder and CMO of Pendulum Entertainment Group.
